title: Radio filter component audit
purpose: Audit radio as its own single-choice component.
objective: Define radio anatomy, single-choice behavior, selected/deselect semantics, layout modes, states, and styling backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: group label, radio input, option label, selected state, reset relationship, segmented-control potential, responsive layout, and QA scenario. Out of scope: checkbox, chips, toggle, swatch, and implementation.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current radio render/CSS/JS files are available.
exit_condition: A radio audit sheet exists with single-choice contracts and customization backlog.
completion_criteria: State matrix and responsive behavior are documented.
acceptance_criteria: Audit distinguishes radio from checkbox and chips.
No plugin source changes are made.
